scope: Qatar medical discovery — Weill Cornell Medicine-Qatar

verifiedFacts.claim: WCM-Q's current four-year application page describes the Four-Year Medical Curriculum as following the Two-Year Pre-medical Curriculum and identifies it as part of the Six-Year Medical Program.
The official WCM-Q application portal states the Fall 2026 cycle is closed and that the next cycle opens in September 2026 for Fall 2027 admission.
WCM-Q reports that 693 medical doctors had graduated since its inaugural 2008 ceremony as of its June 2026 news release.

holdReasons: A current official tuition and full admissions-requirements source suitable for a complete route-specific payload was not established.
No current independent programme recognition/accreditation evidence was established for the necessary recognition badges; historical institutional material is insufficient.

The six-year route includes a distinct two-year pre-medical stage and four-year medical stage, so a complete payload needs unambiguous route-specific admissions, fees, curriculum, clinical and student-living evidence.
nextAction: Obtain current official six-year-program tuition and admissions requirements, independent current recognition/accreditation, and complete clinical and international student-support evidence before packaging.
